name: catqualia-ledger-mcp

tools.name: query_claim
tools.description: Search the CatQualia falsification ledger for claims matching a string, optionally filtered by verdict. Returns the claim, the pre-registered threshold that would refute it, the measured value, and the verdict. The ledger holds 16,217 measured claims including 5,837 the system refuted against its own ground truth.

query.description: substring to match against any field

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.description: Retrieve the recorded verdict for a named check, or find claims containing a phrase. If a check was run more than once, all verdicts are returned in ledger order — a change between them is a ratchet event. Never infers a verdict for a claim that is not in the ledger.

tools.name: what_would_refute
tools.description: Return the pre-registered refutation threshold for matching claims: the measurement that would have killed each claim, recorded before the outcome was known. 16,194 of 16,218 ledger records carry one. Use this to test whether a claim is falsifiable at all.

tools.name: verifier_drift_net
tools.description: Measure the verifier ratchet: whether a system's ability to catch its own false claims is improving or degrading. Re-runs the checks and classifies every verdict transition as hardening or loosening, returning the signed net computed live from the bundled ledger. The current figure is 276 checks re-run, 63 transitions, 31 hardening against 32 loosening — net -1. An earlier published figure of 277/79/38/38/net zero was produced by a grouping bug in the checker and is retracted at https://catqualia.com/corrections.

tools.name: citation_block
tools.description: Return a ready-to-use BibTeX entry and schema.org ScholarlyArticle JSON for a CatQualia publication, so that citing agents cite correctly and resolve the DOI. Call with no slug to list available slugs.

slug.description: publication slug or part of its title

tools.name: atlas_index
tools.description: Return the CatQualia atlas corpus: 79 cross-domain atlases with slug, title, type, URL and DOI — 29 Void Atlases, 45 domain and biomedical, 4 method, 1 institutional audit. Use this to find a published structural-isomorphism mapping for a domain, and to cite it by DOI. Pass kind=void for only the absence-mapping atlases.

kind.description: filter by type: void | domain | method | audit

tools.name: query_atlas
tools.description: Search the 79-atlas corpus by term, returning each match's title, type, URL, DOI and its own void count where it states one. A Void Atlas maps what is ABSENT: targets whose substrate is already characterised and measured and which the field nonetheless does not act on. Use this to check whether a domain has already been mapped before asserting that it has not.

query.description: substring matched against slug, title and description

kind.description: filter by type: void | domain | method | audit

instructions: CatQualia record: a falsification ledger and an atlas corpus. Use these tools to check whether a claim has been measured against ground truth, what would refute it, whether the verification instrument itself is improving, and whether a domain has already been mapped as a structural isomorphism. Every value returned is computed from the published files.
